title: Mkpụrụ Obi Dị n'Arụsị ahụ
intro: N'onyinyo nke nnukwu ọpụpụ site n'aka ọchịchị aka ike, onye a dị omimi chere n'ọzara. Mgbe onye ndu nke ndị a họpụtara ahọpụta rịgoro ugwu nsọ maka oriri Chineke, nnukwu ọnwụnwa dakwasịrị ndị fọdụrụ. Onye a jiri oge ahụ gbanwee nkwenkwe nke obodo dum. Mgbe onye ndu ahụ lọtara na eziokwu, e nyere iwu ntaramahụhụ pụrụ iche na nke ebighị ebi. Ị nwere ike ịkọwa onye mkpụrụ obi a na-ese okwu na aghụghọ bụ?
clues: M gara njem na ndị a tọhapụrụ n'aka onye mmegbu dị ike site na ihe ịrịba ama ọrụ ebube.
Mgbe onye ndu ha rịgoro n'ugwu ahụ ịnata nduzi, echere m n'etiti ndị fọdụrụ.
Achịkọtara m ọla dị oké ọnụ ahịa site n'ihe ịchọ mma ha wee mee ka ọ bụrụ ihe na-emepụta ụda.
Site n'ihe e kere eke a, emere m ka otu ọgbọ dum kwenye na ha ahụla chi ha n'ọzara.
Mgbe onye ndu ahụ lọtara, a kpọpụtara m aha wee jụọ m ihe mere m ji mee ụdị aghụghọ a.
Ntaramahụhụ m n'ụwa a bụ na ọ dịghị onye ga-emetụ m aka ma ọ bụ bịaruo m nso, ihere m na-enwe ruo mgbe ebighị ebi.

options: Nne kamel nke si n'okwute pụta

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: A mara ya ikpe na ọ gaghị emetụ aka, na-asị 'anaghị emetụ aka' mgbe niile
Mmiri gbawara n'akụkụ onye ọchịchị aka ike na ndị agha ya
Tụba n'ime ọkụ nke ghọrọ oyi ma dị jụụ
Ikpuru ìsì mere ka m kpuo ìsì maka ịjụ eziokwu
Ndị ikwu ekworo hapụrụ ya n'ime olulu
outcome.answer: A mara ya ikpe na ọ gaghị emetụ aka, na-asị 'anaghị emetụ aka' mgbe niile

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
